_comment: Kruti Dev 010 <-> Unicode pairs written from the Kruti Dev keyboard rules (the key chart in docs/FONTS.md and the typing guide), NOT copied from the converter's output. They are the phrases src/lib/converterExamples.js shows on the Kruti Dev and DevLys pages, so those pages' examples are compared with something that did not come from the code under test. DevLys 010 uses the same keys for all of these (docs/FONTS.md).

examples.why: short i typed before its letter, U is half na, "k is the letter ssa
reph is Z typed after the syllable, e + s + a for mem + e-matra + anusvara
z is ra under pa, 'u is half sha + na, R is half ta
{ is ksha, = is tra, K is jna

examples.k: Hkkjr dh jkt/kkuh ubZ fnYyh gSA
examples.u: भारत की राजधानी नई दिल्ली है।
